clauses.quote: On the finding of wrongdoing, the member shall repay all of the sick leave credits drawn from the sick leave bank
be subject to other appropriate disciplinary action as determined by the local authority.
clauses.notes: Elliptical clause; subject and modal carried over from preceding clause.

clauses.quote: Upon retirement or transfer of the sick leave bank Member, days on deposit with the sick leave bank shall be withdrawn and transferred with the employee or made accessible for retirement credit, as applicable.
clauses.subject_text: days on deposit with the sick leave bank
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is management/administration.

clauses.quote: Any procedure developed by the Sick Leave Bank Committee shall be uniformly applied to all employees.
clauses.subject_text: Any procedure developed by the Sick Leave Bank Committee

clauses.quote: Voluntary withdrawal from participation in the sick leave bank will be by written notice to the Sick Leave Committee by September 15.
clauses.subject_text: Voluntary withdrawal from participation in the sick leave bank
clauses.notes: Procedural rule governing the method and deadline for voluntary withdrawal.

clauses.quote: Accurate records shall be kept on every transaction of the sick leave bank
all transactions of any nature shall be recorded.
Appropriate administrative forms for administering the sick leave bank shall be developed and maintained by the Sick Leave Bank Committee.
clauses.subject_text: Appropriate administrative forms for administering the sick leave bank

clauses.quote: A donating employee shall not be required to donate a minimum number of catastrophic days to the sick leave bank.
the recipient employee shall have first exhausted all sick and personal leave.
clauses.notes: Extracted from main clause following a subordinate temporal clause.

clauses.quote: Donated days shall become available for use by the particular employee
the particular employee who shall not be required to repay the days.

Any employee who donates sick leave days to the sick leave bank for a particular employee suffering from a catastrophic illness shall be clearly informed that the donated days are not to be recovered or returned to the donor.
clauses.subject_text: Any employee who donates sick leave days to the sick leave bank for a particular employee suffering from a catastrophic illness
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is district administration ensuring informed consent.

clauses.quote: If a particular employee does not require all of the days donated to the credit of the employee, the days shall revert to the credit of those employees who donated the days in accordance with the guidelines adopted by the Sick Leave Bank Committee.
clauses.notes: Conditional clause; duty on administration to process reversion of unused donated days.

clauses.quote: No employee may donate more than 30 sick leave days per calendar year to the sick leave bank for the catastrophic sick leave of anyone employee.
An employee must be a member of the sick leave bank to donate or receive catastrophic sick leave days.
